> Let $t>1$ be a rational number. Is $\sum_{n=1}^\infty\frac{1}{t^n-1}=\sum_{n=1}^\infty \frac{\tau(n)}{t^n}$ irrational, where $\tau(n)$ counts the divisors of $n$? A conjecture of Chowla.
